_description: Default concordance mapping WIOD NIOT/WIOT (Nov16) ISIC Rev.4 sector codes to ABM model sectors. Each code must appear in exactly one model sector. Adjust for your region and research question.
_concordance_notes: The concordance keeps producer sectors economically literal: consumer-goods
manufacturing sectors stay in manufacturing rather than being relabeled as retail.
Household final demand is handled separately by calibrated consumption_ratios and
final_consumption_sectors, so direct household purchases from manufacturing or
agriculture no longer need concordance-level remapping.
